# Rise Personal

> Rise Personal is a personal branding agency that positions founders, executives and experts where reputation is built: in the room first, then online. It works with leaders in Saudi Arabia, Egypt, the GCC and Europe, remotely from Dubai. Founder: Mohamed El Sawaf.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.risepersonal.com/): what Rise Personal does and how it works
- [Personal branding in Saudi Arabia](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-saudi-arabia.html): personal branding for leaders in Riyadh, Jeddah and the Eastern Province
- [Personal branding in Egypt](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-egypt.html): personal branding for leaders in Cairo, Alexandria and across Egypt
- [Human-powered marketing](https://www.risepersonal.com/human-powered-marketing.html): marketing built on people, because people trust people
- [The 12 brand archetypes](https://www.risepersonal.com/archetypes.html): Sage, Creator, Ruler, Hero, Explorer, Magician, Lover, Jester, Everyman, Caregiver, Innocent, Outlaw
- [The Snapshot](https://www.risepersonal.com/snapshot.html): free 4-minute quiz that finds your brand archetype and three words
- [The Journal](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal.html): essays on personal branding, archetypes and the three words people remember you by

## Facts
- Positioning: on the ground first, online second.
- Client work is confidential and starts under an NDA. Clients are never named without written approval.
- Markets: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC, Europe. Languages: English (Arabic planned).
